claim: Exact whole-upper-half-plane circle-reflection chart identity and mirror/reciprocal Joukowski collar algebra.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.required_input: Use the genuine real-endpoint complex semicircle.
obligations.constructed_input: The holomorphic circle Mobius map is ((-a-b)z+2ab)/(2z-a-b); geodesic reflection is its negative conjugate.
obligations.justification: The holomorphic circle Mobius map is ((-a-b)z+2ab)/(2z-a-b); geodesic reflection is its negative conjugate.

obligations.name: Indices
obligations.required_input: Prove identities on the WHOLE upper half-plane.
obligations.constructed_input: No restriction to the boundary equation or sampled points is used. Every positive-imaginary original point has nonzero original denominators.
obligations.justification: No restriction to the boundary equation or sampled points is used. Every positive-imaginary original point has nonzero original denominators.

obligations.name: Domain
obligations.required_input: Keep the genuine source and chart poles explicit.
obligations.constructed_input: Imaginary parts exclude both the circle denominator and real endpoint pole. Reflection preserves the upper half-plane by the exact positive determinant formula.
obligations.justification: Imaginary parts exclude both the circle denominator and real endpoint pole. Reflection preserves the upper half-plane by the exact positive determinant formula.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.constructed_input: The circle Mobius imaginary part is (b-a)^2 Im(z)/normSq(2z-a-b), retaining the actual original endpoints and squared positive determinant.
obligations.justification: The circle Mobius imaginary part is (b-a)^2 Im(z)/normSq(2z-a-b), retaining the actual original endpoints and squared positive determinant.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.required_input: Construct the actual antiholomorphic reflection in chart coordinates.
obligations.constructed_input: Direct complex algebra proves unflatten(conjugate(flatten(z))) equals the same circle reflection on the entire upper half-plane.
obligations.justification: Direct complex algebra proves unflatten(conjugate(flatten(z))) equals the same circle reflection on the entire upper half-plane.

obligations.name: Transition maps
obligations.required_input: Connect reciprocal Schwarz and mirror-side values.
obligations.constructed_input: The literal finite Joukowski expression at -conjugate(w) equals its expression at reciprocal-conjugate(w), including the algebraic zero convention. This is an identity throughout a collar, not only on its unit seam.
obligations.justification: The literal finite Joukowski expression at -conjugate(w) equals its expression at reciprocal-conjugate(w), including the algebraic zero convention. This is an identity throughout a collar, not only on its unit seam.

obligations.name: Identity
obligations.required_input: Keep original chart formulas rather than replace the source.
obligations.constructed_input: The exact reviewed GeodesicCircleFlattening318 is reused byte-for-byte, and the new reflection is proved to equal its chart-conjugated ordinary conjugation.
obligations.justification: The exact reviewed GeodesicCircleFlattening318 is reused byte-for-byte, and the new reflection is proved to equal its chart-conjugated ordinary conjugation.

obligations.name: Consumers
obligations.required_input: Leave original arithmetic word identification to its actual producer.
obligations.constructed_input: This generic algebra supplies the reflection side of the forthcoming original normalizer-word collar comparison. It does not assert that an arbitrary circle matrix is an original normalizer, nor claim global arithmetic descent or completed compact-P1.
